params.name: q
params.description: Search query for full-text and semantic search across server names and descriptions.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results per page (default 10, max 100).

params.name: topK
params.description: Maximum number of candidate results to consider from the search index before pagination. The server applies a hard cap of 500 to keep the rerank window bounded; pass `seed` for stable deep pagination.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in response

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter by specific server IDs.

params.name: qualifiedName
params.description: Exact match on the server's qualified name (e.g. "smithery/hello-world"). Deprecated: use GET /servers/:namespace/:server instead.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Filter by the namespace that owns the server.

params.name: remote
params.description: Filter by remote status. Remote servers are accessed via URL; non-remote servers run locally via stdio.

params.name: isDeployed
params.description: Filter by deployment status. Deployed servers are hosted on Smithery infrastructure.

params.name: verified
params.description: Filter to only verified servers.

params.name: smitheryManaged
params.description: Filter to servers whose namespace is owned by the Smithery org.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: Filter by the server owner's user ID.

params.name: repoOwner
params.description: Filter by GitHub repository owner from repository_url.

params.name: repoName
params.description: Filter by GitHub repository name from repository_url.

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed for deterministic pagination. When provided, results use a stable sort order that is consistent across pages for the same seed value.

items.docs: Search and browse public MCP servers in the Smithery registry. Supports full-text and semantic search via the `q` parameter, and filtering by deployment status, verification, ownership, and more.
